description:
FILED + FIXED s518d (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) from #3284 (Capture-Tiny t/07-stderr-closed.t).
(1) `close STDOUT; defined fileno(STDOUT)` -- perl undef, PCL -1 (defined): the standard handle is a synonym stream over sb-sys's fd-stream, the synonym stays "open" after the close, so %p-fileno-impl's closed test missed and the eq-*standard-output* arm answered.  Capture::Tiny's _proxy_std decides with `! defined fileno STDERR` whether to proxy a closed handle, so it never proxied and the next dup of STDERR failed EBADF.
(2) `open $d, ">&=STDERR"; close STDERR; close $d` -- perl true (the descriptor is refcounted), PCL false EBADF: %p-close-impl asked the alias's TARGET (closed) instead of the alias.
REPRODUCER scratch/s518d/pr/cl4.pl: perl `a=1 b=1 c=1 stdout-after-close=u`; main `a=1 b=0 c=1 stdout-after-close=d`.

=== DONE (s518d, commit 400fb4f6) ===
%p-fileno-impl tests the stream's TARGET for openness; %p-close-impl asks an fdopen alias about itself.  Guard Pl/t/tiehandle-01.t row 24, inverse-verified on main.  07-stderr-closed.t still stops after row 1 -- the next stop is #3372.
subject: fileno of a closed STDOUT/STDERR answered -1 (defined) and an fdopen alias of STDERR failed to close after STDERR was closed
